patch_description: Revert to the best-performing 2-distinct-parameter structure (ry_a + theta) from the prior 0.73-scoring seed, and apply the recommended enhancement: add a YY entangling shell on the same skip-2 qubit pairs as the ZZ skip-2 shell, all sharing the single "theta" parameter. This injects Y-basis coupling orthogonal to the existing Z-basis coupling, densifying the reachable unitary set without adding any new trainable parameters (still only 2 distinct param names: ry_a, theta), which should improve worst-group margin/separation while preserving the excellent parameter economy that drove the 0.73 score. The previous 6-parameter variant (zz_even/zz_odd/rz_a/rz_b) scored lower (0.67), confirming that reducing distinct parameter count and increasing shared entangling structure is the more promising direction.
